account: ESTsoft describes AI-generated activities and conversational companions for older adults. ESTsoft and Gimhae City opened 10 smart senior centers with the companions in January 2024. ESTsoft reported on 8 July 2024 that Yonsei University's Lifetime Sports Laboratory, its partner under an industry-academia agreement, interviewed 40 users in those 10 Gimhae centers. ESTsoft reports that the users described physical, psychological and social satisfaction. The release gives no measured health outcome. In its 2025 submission to the International Telecommunication Union, ESTsoft reports that the system is used in 36 Gimhae senior centers. It also reports work in Japan and a national demonstration that involved 500 participants. The submission describes engagement and testing and gives no measured cognitive, physical, or emotional improvement.
